description: This Dart source file defines the core game state management for a Tic-Tac-Toe mobile game, including representations of game elements, state handling, move application, simple AI logic, score persistence, and UI notification mechanisms.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing the game state, including the game board, current turn, game mode, winner detection, scoring, and move logic.

methods.name: markToText
methods.description: Converts a Mark enum value to its display string ('X', 'O', or empty for 'empty').

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the game mode (vsComputer or twoPlayers), optionally resetting the game board.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game board, optionally resetting accumulated scores and loading scores from persistent storage.

methods.name: _loadScores
methods.description: Loads game scores from local storage.

methods.name: _saveScores
methods.description: Saves current game scores to local storage.

methods.name: playAt
methods.description: Applies a move at a specific index if valid, and triggers AI move if in vsComputer mode.

methods.name: _playComputerIfNeeded
methods.description: Triggers computer move based on current game mode and turn.

methods.name: _chooseBestMove
methods.description: Selects a move for the AI based on heuristics: winning, blocking, or strategic position.

methods.name: _findWinningMove
methods.description: Finds a winning move for a given player if available.

methods.name: _updateWinnerOrNextTurn
methods.description: Determines if there's a winner or draw, updates scores, and switches turn.

methods.name: _calculateWinner
methods.description: Checks the game board for a winning line and returns the winning Mark if found.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Returns a status message reflecting the current game state for UI display.
